test_select_at_instances_of: test the pz.select().at_instances_of() method to select all nodes matching a given type in a pytree
test_select_at_accessor: test the pz.select().at() method with a lambda accessor function to select subtrees by path
test_select_at_subtrees_where: test the pz.select().at_subtrees_where() method to select nodes matching a predicate function
test_selection_apply: test the Selection.apply() method to transform selected nodes with a function in a pytree
test_selection_set_by_path: test the Selection.set_by_path() method to replace selected nodes with new values by keypath
